title: The Mark and Line Primer
summary: A first primer on scratching marks and drawing lines of qi so that a small formation holds for a few breaths.

title: A Handbook of Stone Anchors
summary: A handbook on charging small stones and setting them as anchors that hold a ward in place around the maker.

title: The Ward Draughtsman's Workbook
summary: A workbook of ring and rune drawing that teaches a beginner to trace a ward and a mark that breaks one.

title: A Primer on Cords and Knots of Qi
summary: A primer on throwing and tying cords of qi so that they bind a limb and then pull the maker along.

title: The Lattice Draughtsman's Handbook
summary: A handbook on drawing frames and grids of crossed qi lines to catch blows and bind limbs and read the ground.

title: Beginning Seals for the Qi Maker
summary: A primer on small seals pressed on objects and bodies that guard a latch and mark a hand and jolt a foe.
